question: In which district of Gujarat has the Forest Department intensified the **'Jal-Parab'** campaign to protect wildlife from severe water scarcity during the summer months?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surendranagar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Gujarat Forest Department** has intensified its **Jal-Parab** wildlife support campaign in the **Little Rann of Kutch** in **Surendranagar district** to combat severe water scarcity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jal-Parab** campaign is specifically focused on the **Little Rann of Kutch**, which is located in the **Surendranagar** district of **Gujarat**. Therefore, **Surendranagar** is the correct location.
 
• The initiative is designed to support wildlife species such as the **Indian Wild Ass (ghudkhur)**, **nilgai**, **charak**, and various bird species during peak summer conditions.
 
• As temperatures in the region soar beyond **42-43 degrees Celsius**, the campaign provides a critical support system through **artificial water troughs** and **regular water tankers**.
 
• The other options like **Ahmedabad**, **Junagadh**, and **Gir Somnath** are districts in Gujarat but are not mentioned in the news content as the primary location for the **Jal-Parab** campaign intensification.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **Gujarat government** facilitates wildlife conservation through grants for food, water, and specialized **rescue vans**.
 
• For birds, **saucer cups** have been arranged to ensure they have access to drinking water in the desert ecosystem.
 
• The project involves continuous monitoring and field operations by personnel such as **Beat Guards** and **Forest Guards**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The primary objective of the **Jal-Parab** campaign is to ensure that wildlife does not have to leave its **natural habitat** in search of water, thereby reducing human-wildlife conflict and protecting **biodiversity**.
 
• The campaign strengthens **climate resilience** efforts in the fragile desert ecosystem of the **Little Rann of Kutch**.
